angular_excitation_diagnostic.interpretation: These are only intuitive excitation diagnostics. Actual parameter identifiability is determined by the full wrench Jacobian/SVD, including Euler cross-coupling terms.

assumptions.external_wrench: all residual-wrench samples are treated as iid Gaussian with nonzero empirical mean and 6x6 empirical covariance
assumptions.information_accumulation: sample information matrices are summed, not averaged
assumptions.pose_front_end: raw timestamped pose; degree-5 local polynomial in R3 and geometric Savitzky-Golay on SO3
assumptions.pose_measurement_covariance: translation local-LS covariance is reported diagnostically; a full correlated R3/SO3 measurement model is not yet fused into the wrench likelihood
assumptions.residual_wrench_sampling: every valid centered SG evaluation time is used; there is no confidence-specific temporal subsampling

weak_directions.interpretation: Signed right-singular vector returned by SVD. The whole vector may be multiplied by -1 without changing the mode; relative signs between components are meaningful.

information_vs_duration.remaining_std_fraction_interpretation: 1 means the bag did not reduce prior uncertainty; 0 means the data dominate the prior along that generalized mode.

numerical_linear_algebra.reason: data/prior information may be rank deficient because ridge directions are part of the intended model; ordinary matrix inversion is not used

prior_normalized_confidence.interpretation: The data-only information is compared against the supplied Gaussian prior. Ridge information itself remains in data SVD.

savgol_translation_covariance_diagnostic.note: The local translation covariance is preserved as a diagnostic and is not used directly in the current residual-wrench likelihood.

meaning.external_wrench_replay: Selected 14-D physical parameters and lag are fixed; only the piecewise-linear external wrench is refined. This is the direct check that the pre-existing reconstruction pipeline still works after adding the fourth rotor-effectiveness degree of freedom.
meaning.parameter_only: Selected 14-D physical parameters and selected lag; no external wrench.
meaning.reference: Vehicle-model reference parameters and initial lag; no external wrench.
